kuairec_cohort_instance_d26.npz.prepared_data_license: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International, following the upstream KuaiRec GitHub repository used in the manuscript; see LICENSES.md
kuairec_cohort_instance_d26.npz.changes_made: Video arms were retained, user cohorts were formed from user_active_degree, follow_user_num_range, and register_days_range, 26 cohort objectives were selected, watch-ratio rewards were clipped and normalized to [0,1], and 300 video arms were retained.
kuairec_cohort_instance_d26.npz.objective_construction: Joint cohorts from user_active_degree, follow_user_num_range, and register_days_range.

mu.description: Mean normalized watch-ratio vector for each video arm.

objective_values.description: One variable-length collection of reward samples per arm and objective.
